notes.title: Riftbound - Warlord and Hero Patch v1.2.3
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]
Here is a new patch for Riftbound. Thanks to the fantastic community for all of the feedback on the forum and in the Discord!

[h3]Warlord[/h3]
The third boss battle was quite intense, but could also put you in situations that could take far too long to damage the boss. This combination of intensity and duration could result in a bit of an exhausting battle, so we decided to rework it, in particular the enemies that spawn. While it can still be an intense battle, it should now be easier to damage the boss. Note that higher difficulties have extra enemy spawns, so be on your guard when attempting this boss on higher than Neutral Godlike modes.

There will be more changes to all bosses as we strive find the sweet spot of intensity, difficulty and duration, so we are thankful for any feedback you have.

[h3]Classic Campaign[/h3]
The Classic Campaign will be receiving more changes in future updates, initially however, we wanted to take the edge off the difficulty in some battles, which we have done by increasing the starting energy. This will give you just that bit more to deal with the initial enemies that spawn. The above Warlord boss changes will also make the boss battle easier in the campaign mode.

[h3]Heroic Upgrades[/h3]
A range of balance and functional changes have been made for heroic upgrades, including the addition of a new upgrade that provides more interesting damage options when trying to build DPS heroes. This is the first round of changes that we have for the heroic system and takes onboard a lot of feedback and suggestions, but there will be more in the future. Be sure to let us know which upgrades you are using and in what combination, as we would love to hear how you are using them as part of your strategy.

[h3]Tutorials[/h3]
As previously mentioned, we plan to add some new tutorials to help introduce new players to the mechanics better along the roguelite path. This will be done in a future update.

This isn't the last update, so keep the feedback coming, and we will keep improving the game! Thanks to everyone that has joined the Discord to share their feedback as well, you are all amazing!

Below is the full list of fixes for this update.

[h2]Patch v1.2.3[/h2]
[h3]Balance (General)[/h3]
[list]
[*]In the Classic Campaign, the default starting energy has been increased from 70 to 110
[*]Warlord Boss health reduced from 5500 to 4900
[*]Warlord Boss battle has been redone with different enemy spawns that don’t spawn in front of the boss (which made it difficult to damage the boss). The third phase has also been tweaked (removed 1 barrel throw and added 1 move to the sequence).
[*]Warlord Boss beam will now do more damage to enemies when it is reflected, increased from 1200 to 5000 (it is intended to kill enemies).
[*]Reaper Boss health reduced from 6200 to 5900
[/list]


[h3]Summoner's Path Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]Your last selected run difficulty will now be remembered.
[*]A new Heroic upgrade has been added. Heroic Force is a stackable upgrade that increases critical damage by 20% per stack. This gives you new ways to build damage heroes.
[*]You can now have a maximum of 10 of any stackable upgrade (heroic upgrades).
[*]Bonuses given to a unit in a Fortify tile have been improved. Ranged evasion increased from 40 to 50% chance, melee evasion increased from 20 to 25%, heal increase from 10 to 15 per tick. A 10% damage reduction is now also correctly applied.
[*]All stackable heroic upgrades are now available in the Hero Academy shop (previously only a small number of stackable upgrades were available).
[*]Heroic Rallying Strike upgrade has been changed, to now apply the Strength buff to the first elemental that is an attacker behind (skipping units that do not attack such as Aether-type units).
[*]Heroic Health upgrade has been changed from +20 health to +5% health. This allows you to build tougher tank type heroes.
[*]Heroic Armor upgrade increased from 30 to 60 amor per stack
[*]Heroic Armor Smith upgrade increased from 1 to 2 armor per stack
[*]Heroic Reactive Healing upgrade now targets the unit that has the lowest health as a percentage (i.e the unit with the most missing on the visual health bar which is more intuitive).
[/list]


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Conflagrate, Water Spout, Water Bomb, Zap, Blizzard. Snow Storm, Static Orb, Shocking Intent, Aether Uppercut, Aether Slap and Final Chomp spells, which were incorrectly dealing full damage and Spell Power damage to bosses.

notes.title: Riftbound - Big Balance Patch v1.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]
Here is a new patch for Riftbound. Thanks to Wanderbot, Sifd and the community for all of the feedback that is helping getting balance and progression speed to a really good place.

[h3]Difficulty[/h3]
Difficulty overall has been reduced. There are a few aspects to this, including fixing an issue that could cause large groups to spawn early in wave 1 (which was unintended and felt really unfair). A range of other changes reduce the difficulty on lower difficulty levels as well, including bosses. On top of this, you can now choose the lowest difficulty straight away instead of having to unlock it.


[h3]In-Run Progression[/h3]
The progression during a run felt too slow, (Stage-1 in particular). So you now get more rewards and more coins to spend at the shop. We also try and put spell rewards earlier that can include evolutions and other summon cards, giving you more Summon's and Evolutions much earlier in the run (and more opportunity to get the coveted Stoneling).

[h3]Meta-Progression[/h3]
The last patch did a good job to bring this closer to where we want it. We have have now made some further adjustments to make it a little faster again, as we love the idea of having more perks available sooner, so that even if you don't have heaps of gems to spend, you have more choice on where to spend them. This gives you more opportunity to try out different strategies.

[h3]Tutorials[/h3]
We plan to add some new tutorials to help introduce new players to the mechanics better along the roguelite path. This will be done in a future update.

This isn't the last update, so keep the feedback coming, and we will keep improving the game! Thanks to everyone that has joined the Discord to share their feedback as well, you are all amazing!


Below is the full list of fixes for this update.

[h2]Patch v1.2.2[/h2]
[h3]Balance (General)[/h3]
[list]
[*]The health of Lane Seals has bee increased from 100 to 300, to give you more of a chance to save them.
[*]Skeleton Defender armor reduced from 350 to 250
[*]Warlord boss health reduced from 6100 to 5500 and armor reduced from 1700 to 1000.
[*]Troll Boss health has been reduced from 4800 to 4200, and armor reduced from 1350 to 1100. We felt this fight was taking longer than desired.
[/list]

[h3]Summoner's Path Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased the speed that the end of run gem, stats and unlocks are shown.
[*]Reduce some delays that were causing the loading screen to take longer than it should. In a future patch we will add a continue button here so you can also read the tips.
[*]Evolution Mastery perk unlock requirements changed from 15 to 5 battles
[*]Signature Spell perk unlocked requirement changed from 30 to 15 battles
[*]Fast Learner perk unlock requirements changed from 45 battles to 25 battles
[*]Power Caster perk unlock requirements changed from 60 battles to 35 battles
[*]The Hero Training shop is now always unlocked (previously it became available after you beat the first boss).
[*]All lower difficulty options (Merciful, Tolerant, Lenient) are now unlocked by default so you can choose them straight away.
[*]The default starting difficult has been set to Tolerant instead of Neutral (but Neutral remains unlocked).
[*]Encounters no longer increase danger level (this applies to  Ancient Totems, Enemy Encampment, Oaks Gift, Shrine of Power, Spell Forge, Tactician, Target Practice, The Best Defense, Wild Elementals, Wisp Sanctuary).
[*]Merciful difficulty enemy base health changed from 80% to 60%
[*]Lenient difficulty enemy base health changed from 90% to 75%
[*]Tolerant difficulty enemy base health changed from 95% to 85%
[*]Boss fights no longer spawn Champion enemies on Neutral or lower difficulties.
[*]Boss fights will spawn fewer Elite enemies on lower difficulties.
[*]Reduced occurrences that enemies would repeatedly spawn in the same lane.
[*]The Mutator Encounter will no longer appear on Stage-1 for Neutral and lower difficulties.
[*]Per-Battle Mutators will no longer appear on battles on Stage-1 for Neutral and lower difficulties.
[*]Deadly battles will no longer appear on Stage-1 for Neutral and lower difficulties
[*]Battles with Bonus Coin rewards now give more bonus coins based on the difficulty of the battle. +30/+40/+50/+60 extra bonus coins from Standard/Dangerous/Deadly/Nightmare battles.
[*]The bonus coins rewarded for having a mutator in battle has been increased from 10 per mutator to 25 per mutator.
[*]Adjusted the distribution of Spell Rewards so that you will get more Evolution and Summon choices earlier (in Stage-1).
[*]Increased the number of battles that have Spell Rewards in Stage-1
[*]Spell Power has been increased from 1% to 5% damage per point, to increase the impact of this feature.
[*]You now gain Heroic Transformation charges at level 2 / 6 / 10 / 14 / 18 / 22 (previously 2 / 7/ 12/ 17 / 22). You can still buy extras from the hero shop.
[*]Increased the possible stall duration for Wave 1, and reduced the enemy health condition overall for stalling. This change allows you to stall enemies for longer in Wave 1, and also means the stall limit wont be reached until enemies are lower health.
[*]Slightly increased delays of initial enemy spawns and the delay between spawns. This will give you more time to deal with some enemy groups.
[*]Adjusted enemies that spawn in larger groups, to prevent them from spawning at the start of Wave 1 in battles, which was causing some edge cases of making some early Wave 1 enemies very difficulty and unfair to deal with.
[/list]


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Riftbound - Faster Progression Patch v1.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]
Here is a new patch for Riftbound ([b]aka, the "Retromation" patch[/b]) that addresses some feedback regarding the meta-progression being a little slow. 

[h3]Meta-Progression[/h3]
We don't want the progression to feel like a grind, and instead want it to feel like you are unlocking more choices at a fairly regular pace.

To improve this, you now have more perk options unlocked at the start and you start with some gems to spend. The other perks are also easier to unlock, and you gain more gems from your runs. All of this combined greatly increases the progression speed, and gives the player more agency in choosing how to spend gems before a run much sooner.

[h3]Game Modes Unlocked[/h3]
In addition to this, we no longer lock any game modes behind progression, so you can go ahead and try them all out right away. Keep in mind that each mode offers a significantly different experience:
[list]
[*][b]Summoner's Path:[/b] Rogue-lite mode with progression. Faster battles that require quick thinking and building a deck strategically.
[*][b]Endless Survival:[/b] Rogue-like mode, no meta-progression, but build your deck as you go, build a massive force against a lot of enemies and survive as long as you can.
[*][b]Classic Campaign:[/b] Slower paced at the start, eases you in. This picks up the pace after the first boss battle and becomes more challenging as well.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
There are some balance changes here as well to ease off the difficulty of Corrupted Boars in particular, which can quickly surprise players that haven't encountered them before..

Below is the full list of fixes for this update.

[h2]Patch v1.2.1[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]Endless Survival and Classic Campaign can now be played without having to unlock them.
[*]Corrupted boar health changed from 220 to 180
[/list]

[h3]Summoner's Path Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*]You now start with 50 gems for perks by default (don't worry, existing players get a bonus 50 gems too!)
[*]Tolerant Godlike difficulty is now unlocked by default, so you can start on a lower difficulty
[*]Elemental Toughness perk now starts unlocked, (previously unlocked after 10 battles)
[*]Inquisitive Nature perk now starts unlocked (previously unlocked after 15 battles)
[*]Natural Healing perk now starts unlocked (previously unlocked after 20 battles)
[*]Evolution Mastery perk unlock requirements changed from 30 to 15 battles

[*]Standard battles now reward 15 gems (was 10)

[*]Deadly battles now reward 40 gems (was 30)
[*]Nightmare battles now reward 50 gems (was 40)
[*]Boss battles now reward 60 gems (was 50)
[*]Troll boss now spawns one less soldier in his third phase
[/list]

Classic Campaign will be unlocked however if you already started the campaign before the new game modes were added. This is intended to emphasize that Summoner’s Path is the new primary game mode.

notes.title: Riftbound's Roguelite Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]

If you have seen [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/67d41e913ffbbd746030cd1511efa770c8bb266b.png]our latest roadmap[/url], you know we have some awesome content coming to Riftbound. The massive update includes two new game modes and cosmetic customization.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/67d41e913ffbbd746030cd1511efa770c8bb266b.png[/img]

If you are looking for the latest playtest patch notes, check out the massive patch we just released here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1588340/view/3655271993671621232?l=english

[h2]From The Developers[/h2]
This content update is quite literally, game changing. A tonne of work has gone into this, and we are really happy with how the "new way to play" (via the Roguelite game mode) has turned out.
[h3]Trust me, you are going to love it! [/h3]

If you already own Riftbound, you can try out the new game mode right now in the public playtest. If you haven't got it yet, it's on sale right now, so use the opportunity to grab your copy and get a taste of the new game experience.

[h1]Tell Me More![/h1]

[h3]New Game Modes[/h3]
Two new game modes have been added, giving you endless replayability. The first of these is "Summoner's Path", a new Roguelite adventure with permanent progression and procedurally generated runs, encounters, danger levels & more.  The second is an Endless Survival mode which features a number of different scenarios and mutator options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/18cce5e024d11aebc3a9ecb235bfdaca86a67a37.png[/img]

[i]A procedurally generated map, with random encounters and rewards.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/1594574e81df38ba37d90a3abed00ef88a66d57e.png[/img]

[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]
There are a variety of new mechanics that have evolved over the past few months, thanks to feedback from our playtesers. This includes new spells mechanics, a new elite system, a new hero system and a new mutator system.

[b]Elite System[/b]
The elite system allows the enemy to spawn elite and champion units which have extra affixes attached to them that make them more challenging. There is a good variety of affixes that can make enemies tougher, deadlier, or give them unique effects. Bosses have affixes too!

[b]Heroic System[/b]
The new Hero system turned out to be a huge hit. It allows you to choose stackable heroic upgrades, and turn your elementals into heroic units during battle. We have a nice range of stackable heroic upgrades, plus a range of rare unique heroic upgrades,

[b]Mutator System[/b]
Mutators can significantly change a battle, introducing new rules or mechanics to an entire battle. Each endless scenario will have different optional mutators, but you will also encounter them in the new roguelite game mode. There are 18 very unique mutators which are really fun and challenging - they have added a huge amount of variety and replayabilty to the game.

[b]Spell Power, Status Effects & More[/b]
[b]Spell Power[/b] is a new in-run persistent stat that allows your spells do deal additional True Damage. You can purchase spell power at the shop, obtain it from meta-perks and even get it from upgrades.

[b]True Damage[/b] is a new type of damage that can't be evaded, blocked or resisted. Some mechanics and rare spells can deal true damage.

[b]Evasion, Block, Regen, Strength, Weakness, Marked & Shatter[/b] are new status effects that can be applied to allies and enemies alike. We have added a bunch of new spells & upgrades that use these new status effects.

[h3]In-run Shop Events[/h3]
The roguelite mode, "Summoner's Path", features a map with branching paths. Sometimes these branches will lead you to shop events. "Chomper Joe's Magic Emporium" sells a range of spells and upgrades, and "Sergeant Metal's Hero Academy" allows you to purchase the coveted range of unique hero upgrades. You will have to choose your path carefully as it will effect your strategy in the battles ahead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/072d05ac24a3716946960cb045b7c03032c3719e.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
Around 40 new spells & rare spells have been added, plus more than 40 new upgrades. A group of new enemies (that are completely unique) have also been added. This is all on top the new game modes which have their own content including a large range of encounters, mutators and enemy affixes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/05fca63219632fd6af0ac7f6afd451ab96d61f93.jpg[/img]


[h3]New Character Customization[/h3]
The new cosmetic customization is really fun way to customize your elementals! You will be able to unlock parts with stars and also as progression through the new game modes. Then you can add these parts to your elemental characters to create interesting and unique looks. We are experimenting with the degree of control you will have, such as positioning, scale, rotating, and changing the color of parts. We are super excited to see the creations everyone comes up with![img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/414cb06305db547cf2fd20566f16caffc0aec2bf.jpg[/img]

[h3]QoL and UI improvements![/h3]
UI and quality of life improvements have also been added. Including the much requested ability to change the order of spells to suit keybinds!


[h3]How to access the new content[/h3]
[b]This content is a free DLC update, and there are no microtransactions![/b]
The public test for this update is live, so if you own Riftbound you can try it [b]right now[/b]! We are a small indie dev team, if you want to join the growing player base we would love to have you! You can join our Discord server to chat with the devs if you have any questions, and share your feedback.

[h1]How To Access The Playtest[/h1]
You can access the playtest directly on Steam.
[olist]
[*]Right Click "Riftbound" in your Steam library and choose "Properties"
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/ccec68336c852a220122c5fdf9a46cc84c4969d5.png[/img]
[olist]
[*]Chose "public_playtest" from the list. Steam will download this branch of the game, and once that is done you can play.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/ce3110a20d55c59ba5f48f3331a3c25632c7d251.png[/img]

[h3]To return to the normal live build of the game[/h3]
Repeat these steps but choose "None" for step 2.



[h1]Join Us - Discord[/h1]
We are very active devs and you are more than welcome to join our discord or leave your feedback on the Steam forum. This is just the beginning of very exciting times ahead!
[url=https://discord.gg/4Xz6qNpwH5]Join discord here[/url]

notes.title: Riftbound - Massive Playtest Patch v1.1.4
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]
If you haven't heard about the new game mode update yet, be sure to check here first:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1588340/view/3655271993671627277?l=english

This one is a really large patch, which includes further changes to the playtest build, with new mechanics, more content and QoL changes.  Below is the full list!


[h2]From the Devs[/h2]
Feedback has been very constructive (big shout out to the players hanging out and giving feedback in Discord, you are all so awesome!) , and we have been happy with the direction of the playtest. This new update focuses on content, with new spells, upgrades, mechanics and enemies, as we get closer to the full release in the coming months.

[h3]Stage-3 is active[/h3]
Stage 3 of the run is now active, see if you can get past the 3rd boss!

[h3]QoL and spell selection[/h3]
You can now choose your spells before heading into battle, which means you can also customize the order of your spells, giving you control over how you want to use your the spell slot keybinds. We are also trialing a new targeting feature, so be sure to provide feedback on that.

[h3]Hero Academy[/h3]
A new type of shop has been added! "Sergeant Metal's Hero Academy" is the place to go when you want the unique heroic upgrades. Choose from the latest heroics such as Mercenary, Flanking & Hero Landing!

[h3]Content, content, content[/h3]
One of the big focuses on this patch was getting all of the content finalized and implemented. As such, almost all of the perks, encounters, affixes, spells & upgrades are now available. We do have another small set of spells still to come, and we are finalizing Stage 4 of the run.

The Customizer has also been updated, now ALL elemental's are available to be customized, and the parts lists have been updated with new parts.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
From here there are a few more things to add, but a lot of the focus will shift to polish, bug fixing and balance. The playtest build will continue to be updated so you get to try everything out and provide feedback.

For now, enjoy the patch notes below!

[h2]Patch v1.1.4[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]New game Title Screen
[*]Added a new targeting curve for better spell casting UI feedback (let us know what you think, this may end up being a game option).
[*]The top of screen upgrade point counter is no longer shown in the character customizer, endless mode or summoner’s path, as it is not needed.
[*]In battle, icons for active mutators are now shown above the wave bar.
[*]Artwork has been updated for many existing spells.
[*]Update the Stunned status VFX

[list]
[*]Maximum stage is now 3 (along with the Stage 3 boss).
[*]A new battle preparation screen now shows before entering a battle, including details of the battle mutators and allowing you to organise your spells.
[*]You can now take up to 10 spells into battle. Consumable spells and evolutions are excluded from this limit (and you are unlikely to reach this limit until Stage 4 in the run).
[*]The new Spell Power feature has been added. Spell Power is persistent for a run, it can be purchased from the shop and obtained from special events and upgrades. For each point of spell power, attack spells deal 1% extra damage (rounded up) as True Damage (which cannot be evaded, blocked or resisted).
[*]New shop type “Sergeant Metal’s Hero Academy” has been added. This will start appearing in runs after you have beat the first boss, and allows you to purchase unique hero upgrades.
[*]The Power Caster perk is now implemented.
[*]The Golden Luck perk is now implemented.
[*]The Fast Learner perk is now implemented.
[*]The Veteran Heroes perk is now implemented.
[*]The Scribe perk is now implemented.
[*]A new enemy, Eye of Newt, is gazing upon the battlefield and can appear from Stage 2.
[*]A new enemy, Corrupted Boar, is charging onto the battlefield and can appear from Stage 1.
[*]A new enemy, Molten Hound, is heating up the battlefield and can appear from Stage 3.
[*]A new enemy, Bomber Bat, is demolishing the battlefield and can appear from Stage 3.
[*]New Encounters: Shimmering Pool, Shrine of Attunement, Shrine of Purification, Corrupted Shrine, Long Rest, Wisp Sanctuary II, Spell Forge
[*]The Shimmering Pool encounter introduces new upgrades: Relic of Power, Relic of Blocking, Relic of Regeneration, Relic of Strength, Relic of Marking. 
[*]The Shrine of Attunement. Encounter introduces new Upgrades: Aether Attunement, Electric Attunement, Fire Attunement, Physical Attunement, Water Attunement.
[*]New upgrades can be found as battle rewards and in the shop: Spell Trick, Grand Entrance, Permafrost, Healing Boost, Rapid Evolution, Economic Evolution, Tranquil Evolution, Burning Evolution & Stunning Evolution.
[*]New Heroic upgrades can be found in the new training shop: Flanking, Mercenary, Sacrifice & Hero Landing.
[*]New spells have appeared along the Summoner’s Path. Boon of Strength, Boon of Blocking, Moonbeam, Rock Strike,  Shocking Intent & Water Bomb. The updated Cleanse spell can now be found as well.
[*]New RARE spell cards can now be found in your adventures, including Blizzard Rare, Cleanse Rare, Fiery Explosion Rare, Rock Wall Rare, Snow Storm Rare, Static Orb Rare, Time Shift Rare, Lightning Strikes Rare, Rock Strike Rare, Moonbeam Rare, Shocking Intent Rare & Water Bomb rare.
[*]New mutators have been added: Anti-Magic, Barrelfield, Bats of War, Bloodlust, Cursed Mark, Elemental Instability, Guard Up, Mad Forest, Malediction, Pergatory, Portal Mischief
[*]New Enemy Affixes have appeared: Blocking Aura, Regen Aura, Strength Aura, Deathlock

notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]
If you haven't heard about the new game mode update yet, be sure to check here first:

This update includes  further changes to the playtest build, with new systems and QoL changes.  Below is the full list!


[h2]From the Devs[/h2]
Feedback has been very constructive, and we have been happy with the direction of the playtest. This new update focuses on map generation, a new shop system and the hero system.

[h3]Shops & Coins[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/a9f03534d3ee0d531eece7b67468ac14476f0265.png[/img]
A new currency "Coins" have been added as the currency used during a run. Coins are obtained from battles, and there will be various ways to earn bonus coins. Gems are still the meta-currency, and will now be calculated at the end of your run.

The new shop system led to some new opportunities with map generation which continues to improve in each iteration. Some key changes have been made to how rewards are randomly distributed, and map paths now allow for the shop to show up in place of a battle.

[h3]Hero System[/h3]
The hero system has turned out to be quite popular and is a fun way to gain more control over your battle strategy. Overall, we weren't 100% happy with the rewards given for level up, so we have added a number of more unique hero upgrades that can be chosen during level up that can even interact with each other. Combined with the hero encounter, you can have some interesting hero builds.


[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
There is lots more to come - from here we will be working on opening up the Stage 3 map to the playtest and adding some of the new enemies and more new spells & upgrades. The playtest build will continue to be updated so you get to try everything out and provide feedback.

There are also some more QoL, and UI changes we plan to make around keybinds (and providing some extra information about battles).

notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]

The new huge update for Riftbound [b]is now live[/b] on the public test branch for all Riftbound players. Below are some notes on what to expect, and instructions on how to access it.

If you are able to join our Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/4Xz6qNpwH5]Join discord here[/url]) that would be great, as it's the best way to discuss the content, provide feedback and let us know how you are doing with the difficulty. Alternatively, let us know directly on the Steam forum ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1588340/discussions/]here[/url]).

[h2]What to expect - State of the game[/h2]
Please keep in mind this is a [b]beta playtest[/b], so there will be bugs, some incomplete Art/UI/VFX/Sounds. We have done internal testing already, and don't anticipate any major issues.

In addition to the huge new game modes (Summoner's Path & Endless Survival), other new content has also been added.

[*]New game modes Summoner's Path (rogue-lite) and Endless Survival

notes.title: New Game Experience On The Way!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]

Next week we plan to have the public test of our major new content update available to all Riftbound players. In advance of that, we wanted to share some details on the new game experience for both new and existing players.

[h2]Classic Campaign[/h2]
Before getting into the new game modes, we just want to clarify that the current game mode (the story campaign of around 40 levels) will still be available as the "Classic Campaign" mode.

[h2]New Game Modes[/h2]
Two new game modes will be available, "Summoner's Path" and "Endless Survival"[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/eca233cbccc6962289210a4f326d6900356fb298.png[/img]
- Summoner's Path is a Roguelite game mode with permanent progression
- In Endless mode you can battle against endless waves of enemies.

[h2]The New Player Experience[/h2]
There is still a bunch of work to do in the coming months to finalise the content for these game modes (it really is a massive update) - but we fully expect Summoner's Path to become the default mode for new players. 

In Summoner's Path, you get to experience most of the content from the Classic Campaign (minus the story), and a lot of new content, in a faster paced game with permanent progression. Each run is different as you discover new spells, upgrades & encounters.

From there, the experience offered in Endless Mode is quite different. While Summoner's Path features shorter strategic battles of varying difficulties, Endless Mode is a constant build-up of endless waves, with enemies that increase in difficulty and number. There will be 4 separate scenarios, each scenario offering a different enemy arrangement. Each scenario also has a normal mode, plus 2 unique mutators unique to each scenario for an added challenge.

So if you are a new player to Riftbound, there is going to be tonnes of content that we expect could easily give you at least 50 hours of playtime.

[h2]The Existing Player Experience[/h2]
Many of our existing players have completed the story campaign and experienced a range of spells, upgrades and enemies. Both of the new game modes will feature many of the same spells & upgrades you have come to love - but we have also added a host of new content to keep the experience fresh for existing players.
[list]
[*]New spells & upgrades (including unique spells & upgrades from encounters).
[*]New status effects and mechanics (weakness, block, marked and more)
[*]New mutator system (in both Summoner's Path and Endless Mode)
[*]New enemies to keep you on your toes
[*]Elite enemies with a new random affix system
[*]Heroic allies with new Heroic Upgrades
[*]Rewards & unlocks in the new character customizer, design your heroes that appear in battles
[/list]

The new experience has a lot of offer for existing players, and we can't wait for you to experience it.


[h2]The Playtest[/h2]
The Playtest introduces you to the first 2 stages of Summoner's Path, and the first 2 scenarios of Endless Mode. This is a beta playtest so you can expect a few bugs and unfinished content, plus we still have new spells, upgrades, encounters and enemies that will be added.
[list]
[*]First 2 stages of Summoner's Path
[*]First 2 scenarios of Endless Mode
[*]Some of the new spells &  upgrades (more to come)
[*]Expect some bugs, and incomplete artwork/VFX/sounds
[*][b]Have your say[/b], and provide feedback & offer suggestions
[/list]


You can access the playtest directly on Steam. We will post some instructions once it is available. Feel free to join us on Discord however, where you can chat directly with the devs and other players (everyone is really friendly), that is the best way to share your feedback, alongside the Steam forums.

[h2]Stay Tuned[/h2]
Be sure to check back for more updates as we go deeper into some other mechanics in the new game modes including how the heroic system works, mutators, elites, character customization & more!


[h3]How to access the new content[/h3]
[b]This content is coming as a free update, and there are no microtransactions![/b]



[h1]Join Us - Discord[/h1]
We are very active devs and you are more than welcome to join our discord or leave your feedback on the Steam forum. This is just the beginning of very exciting times ahead!

notes.title: Summoner's Path
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer! Happy Holidays![/h1]

Summoner's Path is one of the upcoming game modes being added to Riftbound. An entirely new experience featuring:
[list]
[*]Permanent progression
[*]New perk system
[*]New spells & upgrades
[*]New mutator system
[*]New enemies
[*]Elite enemies & heroic allies
[*]Rewards & unlocks
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/a664af7f699ce73c302f4eb5c8dd8df5dbde7a9a.png[/img]

It's a massive update, to the extent where we expect this game mode to become the default way to play (don't worry, the classic campaign mode will still be there).

[h2]The Experience[/h2]
After spending gems on perks you can start your run. Choose your starting elemental and choose the path you will take. Some paths are more dangerous than others but may have greater rewards, and some paths have encounters that can give you powerful abilities. New content and encounters are unlocked after each run, giving you a different experience each time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/5cd1cff675ac3a4ca972048844b344ce5630fef8.png[/img]

[h2]Danger Level[/h2]
Each time you move along the map the Danger Level increases, and many encounters also increase the danger level. Danger Level effects enemy spawning in battles, higher danger levels effectively allow the enemy to spawn more units. So it's a good idea to balance your path, deciding which rewards to go for and which encounters.

[h2]Battle Types[/h2]
There are currently 4 types of battles, standard, dangerous, deadly and boss battles. Dangerous battles will spawn elite enemies, and Deadly battles will spawn elites & champion enemies. The pay-off for doing the more difficult battles is a higher gem reward, and also more choice rewards (spells/upgrades).

On top of these battles there is a mutator system which can really mix things up and increase the challenge (while providing some bonus rewards of course).

[h2]New Designs[/h2]
Along with all of the new features, we have new designs for a range of UI elements, including new spell cards & upgrade design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/245c0b094573913568994eee80863c3d955d56ce.png[/img]

[h2]Playtest Coming Soon[/h2]
We are aiming to give all Riftbound players access to the new game modes in the coming weeks, allowing you to provide feedback. Have a chat with us if you need help accessing it.

notes.title: Riftbound Roadmap News
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]

If you have seen [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/67d41e913ffbbd746030cd1511efa770c8bb266b.png]our latest roadmap[/url], you know we have some awesome content coming to Riftbound. The massive update includes two new game modes and cosmetic customization.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/67d41e913ffbbd746030cd1511efa770c8bb266b.png[/img]

[h2]From The Developers[/h2]
This is a huge update and we are really happy with the progress and how everything is coming together. There are several new systems and new mechanics that are really exciting. We are working on bringing everything together so that we can start public playtesting (everyone that owns the game will have access to this and be able to provide feedback).

[h1]Sneak Peak[/h1]
(Please note this is work in progress, subject to change and not final artwork)

[h3]New Game Modes[/h3]
Two new game modes are on the way, giving you endless replayability. The first of these is Summoners Path, a new Roguelite adventure with permanent progression and procedurally generated runs, encounters, danger levels & more.  The second is an Endless Survival mode which features a number of different scenarios and mutator options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/18cce5e024d11aebc3a9ecb235bfdaca86a67a37.png[/img]

[i]A procedurally generated map, with random encounters and rewards.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/9524024bc7e814e76b01d6c27b5fd3062747aaff.png[/img]

[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]
There are a variety of new mechanics spread throughout the new game modes. This includes new spells mechanics, a new elite system, a new hero system and a new mutator system.

[b]Elite System[/b]
The elite system allows the enemy to spawn elite and champion units which have extra affixes attached to them that make them more challenging. There is a good variety of affixes that can make enemies tougher, deadlier, or give them unique effects.

[b]Heroic System[/b]
We are also testing a new heroic system, allowing you to choose stackable heroic upgrades, and turn your elementals into heroic units during battle. This brings some exciting progression to the game and is a great way to tackle the new challenges the enemy is going to throw at you.

[b]Mutator System[/b]

notes.title: Riftbound - Patch v1.0.4
notes.content:
Update v1.0.4 is now live!  Thanks to everyone that provided feedback.  Be sure to check out the roadmap (pinned in the forum), this is the next update for phase 1 of the roadmap.   


[h2]From the Devs[/h2]
The full patch notes are below, here are comments we have regarding the changes.  This patch focuses on further significant pacing changes, UI improvements and some balance changes.

[b]Significant Pacing Changes[/b]
The previous update (v1.0.3) improved the pacing of Chapter 1 with shorter levels, but we wanted to take further steps towards getting players into mechanics & features sooner (especially the spell book).  In this new update we have reduced the number of levels in the first chapter by re-working the levels and combining tutorials.  

[b]Upgrades - Permanent Progression[/b]
Upgrades that you unlock as you progress through the campaign (by defeating bosses) are now permanently unlocked.  This means that you can return to earlier levels and use them - even before the boss fight!  This improves replayability, and also gives you new ways to tackle levels on hard mode.

(We are considering doing something similar for spells in a non story-breaking way in a future update)

[b]Health Bars - Per Unit[/b]
Health bars are now available per-unit!  They are enabled by default and can be turned off in the options.  The previous method for checking health still exists, but we have found the new method  provides better feedback as you are playing.  Since health bars only show when a unit is damaged, it doesn't cause information overload.

[b]More UI Improvements[/b]
You can now view both spell and upgrade tooltips during a battle. For spells you simply hover over the spell card, and for upgrades we have added icons to the top right corner.

We have also increased the size of the cost text on the existing cards by default, and if you want your spell cards even bigger, you can use the new Spellbar UI Scaling setting in the game options.

[b]New Keybinds[/b]
Extra keybinds have been added for adjusting battle speed, and also for spell slots 7 - 10.  You may need to bind these or reset your bindings in the options if you have previously applied options.  

We will continue to provide more updates to balance as needed, so keep the feedback coming in!

notes.title: Riftbound - Patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
Update v1.0.3 is now live!  Thanks to everyone that provided feedback.  Be sure to check out the roadmap, this is the first of a series of updates for phase 1 of the roadmap.   


[h2]From the Devs[/h2]
The full patch notes are below, here are our comments we have regarding the changes.  This patch focuses on pacing, balance, and improvements to the perspective.

[b]Perspective Changes[/b]
Players handle depth perception differently, changes in this patch will help with the 3D perspective. All elementals are closer to the ground & have darker shadows, and a new row & column highlight feature helps summoning elementals into the correct lane (can be disabled in the options).

[b]Pacing[/b]
Chapter 1 was designed to ease players in and make the game accessible for players new to the genre.  We felt the pacing in this chapter was too slow, making it take too long to get to the really cool mechanics like the spell book and upgrades.  To address this we have shortened all of the levels in Chapter 1 (in most cases by 1 wave).  This still allows players to be eased in and learn the ropes, but they can get through the content quicker, and into the really fun levels in Chapter 3 and beyond.

[b]Balance[/b]
Riftbound offers 3 separate difficulties. "Hard" is intended to offer a significant challenge, but "Normal" is intended to be suitable for more players.  Some enemies were making some levels more difficult than intended, namely the [b]Summoner[/b] (who became too powerful if not interrupted and left unchecked), and the Reaper Boss fight - which relied too much on knowing some special mechanics.

In this patch, the Reaper's damage and the overall fight should now be easier on "Normal".  Some changes to how the abilities work will also help with this, including Spirit Shield completely blocking damage from the special boss attacks that can be reflected.

The Summoner was in a tricky place.  When interrupted in time, they weren't much of a problem - but if you didn't interrupt they could quickly snowball with a large army of restless skeletons!  We addressed this in two ways.  Firstly the skeletons summoned now deal less damage, and more importantly, a Summoner will only summon new skeletons if it has less than 3 active summons, preventing the snowball effect and making it less reliant on interrupts.

We will continue to provide more updates to balance as needed, so keep the feedback coming in!

[h2]Patch v1.0.3[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Recall now returns more energy based on the elemental Tier being recalled (20 x Tier)
[*]Enemies can now be pushed into lanes before they reach the battlefield when using Water Spout

[*]Added a new game option to enable quick casting with spell keybinds (disabled by default)
[*]Elementals have been moved closer to the ground where possible to help with depth perception
[*]The shadow from elementals is now darker to make it clearer which tile they are on
[*]Adjusted the height of the evolution buttons so they are closer to the elemental that is evolving
[*]Reduced the volume of the Victory sound effect screen slightly
[*]Cutscene fastmode speed increased from 2x to 4x
[*]Updated the look of the lane tiles in the Enchanted Forest environment
[/list]

[h3]Reaper Boss Fight[/h3]
[list]
[*]Slash (red spinners) base damage reduced from 40 to 20, and damage per hit is reduced by 50% instead of 25%
[*]Scythe Throw initial end tile impact damage reduced from 300 to 50% of combined max health
[*]Scythe Throw damage on return reduced from 100 to 80
[*]Scythe Throw no longer deals damage on impact to a unit with Spirit Shield
[*]Doom Toll tick damage reduced from 10+10% to 0+3% per second
[*]Doom Toll prefers to target closer elementals first
[*]Phase 1 - Reduced Wraith spawns from 2 to 1 (except hard)
[*]Phase 2 - Reduced Spear spawns from 2 to 1 (all difficulties) & Wraith spawns from 2 to 1 (except hard)
[*]Phase 3 - Changed Defender+Soldier pair to a Soldier (all difficulties) and removed a Defender+Spear pair (except hard)
[/list]

[h3]Giant Troll Boss Fight[/h3]

[*]Club Slam no longer deals damage to a unit with Spirit Shield, as this reflects the projectile
[*]Club Slam initial impact now only hits 1 tile in front of the Troll instead of 2
[*]Club Slam can now be reflected in Tile 7 (previously it had to be done in Tile 6 or lower)
[*]Rock Throw damage to elementals changed from 400 to 50% of combined max health, and now stuns the unit it hits. Still deals 400 damage to any skeletons it hits.
[/list]

[h3]Warlord Boss Fight[/h3]

[/list]

[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurer![/h1]

We are excited to [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/62adaf0555c89733ad15fb372d5718da74646978.png]share our roadmap[/url] of updates and new content planned for the game.  You can read below for extra details.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/62adaf0555c89733ad15fb372d5718da74646978.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/62adaf0555c89733ad15fb372d5718da74646978.png[/img][/url]

[h2]From The Developers[/h2]
After a smooth v1.0 launch, we are excited to be working on further improvements and content for the game.  Here are our thoughts on some key areas we plan to address.

[h3]Chapter 1 Pacing[/h3]
The original intention for Chapter 1 was to ease players into the game at a slow pace, and while this is okay for players new to the genre, the pacing in the first group of levels can feel a little slow at times for experienced players.  We will be making adjustments to levels in this chapter so you can progress faster, and get to the really fun mid-late game mechanics and spells sooner.

[h3]Difficulty Adjustments & Balancing[/h3]
Some levels on "Normal" difficulty are a little harder than we would like, part of this is because of enemies such as the pesky Summoner, and brutal Reaper Boss.  Over the course of a few updates we will be making balance changes to some enemies, and also to the wave balancing on some levels.

notes.title: Enemy Armor System
notes.content:
Enemies in Riftbound use an armor system that allows enemies to have pieces of armor equipped that can be broken off as they take damage.  

Armor is represented on the health bar (in yellow), and visually on the enemy models.  As you damage and wear down the armor, pieces of armor break off.  This fun to see in battle, and helps you identify just how big a threat the enemy is and what you need to focus on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/a9417b53ae21c61f413c1b305da52fe911ee4182.png[/img]

Standard enemies typically have 3 pieces of armor (braces, pauldrons and helmet), but this can vary between enemies.  Stronger enemies also carry a shield.

[h1]Boss Battles[/h1]
During our Boss Battles we make use of the same system, allowing you to determine visually how much damage has been done as the boss enters new attack phases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/eea4676e9825d5608217ab0d7f138dfd276e12f8.png[/img]

In some battles you may face more armored enemies, and in other battles you may face large numbers of weak enemies - this will play into how you choose your spells and setup your strategy.  Some spells and defender attacks deal bonus armor damage multipliers, and will be a key part of your strategy for dealing with enemy armor.

[i]Pummel is an awesome combo spell that is super effective against armor, so be sure to try it out when facing armored legions.[/i]

notes.title: Difficulty Levels!
notes.content:
Everyone enjoys playing games at different difficulty levels, and whether you are a strategy game veteran or new to the genre, it's nice to have the option to relax and play, or turn things up and challenge yourself.

In Riftbound we currently have 3 difficulty levels (Casual, Normal & Hard), and are looking at ways to add an extra difficulty level on top of this post-release.   Our goal has always been to avoid health padding where possible (i.e. just giving enemies more health), and instead have other systems that highlight differences between the difficulty modes. 

All of the campaign levels in Riftbound are hand made and tested at each difficulty level, and we have some really nice control over how enemy waves spawn.   Here are some of the factors we are able to tweak:
[list]
[*] The delay between spawns per difficulty
[*] How long you can stall enemies for per difficulty
[*] Which enemies spawn and how many per difficulty
[/list]

That's just the first level of control we have.   On top of that we have the ability to adjust enemy health, speed, damage and abilities.   As an example, the Summoner in hard mode spawns additional skeleton minions, and the Commander uses a more powerful inspire buff on enemies to make them move faster.

Finally, we also have control over adjustments for special levels such as Challenge Levels and Boss Battles.  This allows us to move objectives and change victory requirements.  A great example of this is Challenge Levels that require you to occupy fort tiles.  On hard mode there are more tiles to occupy and some of them are closer to the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/6cc94d1a35cc2fd3104bbfb3b942570e7a8cac5d.png[/img]

[b]Casual (Story/Easy)[/b]
In this mode we adjust the timing of enemies and make minor adjustments to health/armor values.  This is great if you just want to play through the story.  You can still lose if you aren't careful, but in general you can get away with more mistakes, have more time to react to threats, and the strategy you choose isn't too critical.

[b]Normal Mode[/b]
In normal mode you need to be a little more selective with your strategies, and if you make too many mistakes the enemy might still overrun you - but you will usually have a chance to recover and win the battle.  

[b]Hard Mode[/b]
In hard mode enemies have what we consider "full" health and armor values.  Multiple strategies will still be viable, but you will need to be more selective of your strategy to suit the battle.  The enemy will punish you more for mistakes, and resource management is going to be more important than lower difficulties.   Some special enemies have had their abilities adjusted and you will find them more of a threat, and bosses will do more to keep you on your toes.

You will also want to take advantage of certain game mechanics when playing hard mode, such as the ability to interrupt enemy attacks (if a big enemy is taking a slow heavy swing at your defender, stun him mid swing to prevent it), stalling enemies, smart positioning of defenders, and choosing upgrades to optimize your strategy.

Balancing takes a lot of work, and we go through several balance revisions until each difficulty feels right.  The game is going to be fully supported through and after launch, so [b]we will continue to tweak the balance and adjust things as required based on feedback.[/b]

notes.title: A Look at The Air Element
notes.content:
Air is a unique element that is made up of wind and electric based attacks.  This makes it a flexible element that features a good amount of damage and utility.  Air has enough flexibility and balance to use on it's own, but it is also the perfect element to use along side other elements.  

[h3]Elementals[/h3]
The base elemental for air is the Airling.  As you discover evolutions through the game you gain access to multiple evolution branches.  The primary branch focuses on electric attacks that have a chance to apply various effects to your enemies, and the secondary branch is based on wind with special targeting features.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/5e6e075f252b4833efb4356185d4fe6c102aedd7.png[/img]

[h3]Status Effects[/h3]
Air has some unique status effects that are mostly provided from electric based attacks.  While not as reliable or consistent as status effects from the water element, the electric status effects have the chance to stun enemies or chain damage to other enemies.  The true balance between utility and damage, with a sprinkle of luck.

[h5]Air is fun to use, with awesome lightning effects that make this a fan favorite![/h5]

[*]Evolving elementals during battle

Everyone is really, really loving the ability to evolve elementals during battle which we are happy to hear as this is one of our key features.  We are also happy to hear that players are enjoying using the tactical spells such as Water Spout and Rock Wall to move enemies around and control the pace of the battle.

Players are also sharing some of the strategies they are using, and it's great to see people adapting strategies they have used in other games (like Plants vs Zombies) into our game.  Plants vs Zombies is by far the game with the highest similarity according to our feedback with players calling it a "Fantasy version of plants vs zombies" and "Plants vs Zombies meets Pokemon".  This is really awesome to hear as one of our goals has been to bring this genre back to PC players.

notes.title: A Look at The Water Element
notes.content:
Water is a fun element to to include in your strategy, involving Elementals and Spells that deal moderate damage and include utility and status effects.   It's a great element for slowing down the enemy, giving you more time to react and deal with threats.

[h3]Elementals[/h3]
The base elemental for water is the Waterling.  As you discover evolutions through the game you gain access to multiple evolution branches.  The primary branch focuses on increasing the effectiveness of the slowing feature of water based attacks, and the secondary branch is based on support (in the form of an aura) which can significantly boost other Elementals in the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40431179/d5fa1745c9b5e066cbf654adba3cf0f600d58970.png[/img]

[h3]Status Effects[/h3]
When used against enemies, many water based spells and attacks include a slowing status effect.  There are different degrees of slowing depending on whether your enemy is wet, chilled or frozen.  

Water has another unique aspect, as it is one of the few elements that interact with other elements.  The interaction with electric and fire attacks will form an important part of your strategy when choosing spells.

[h5]Water is fun to use, and has the utility to save you from some tricky situations![/h5]
